“My glare will pierce the dark, my brilliance will dispel the gloom.”

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: Where did you— How— ... huh? (Cannot be fabricated, must be found or gifted)

Class: Iconic EQ Very Heavy Melee • Skill: Melee • Range: 4m/yds

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: None • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: If this weapon reduces a target to 0 HP, then for the next 9 seconds (3 Rounds) this weapon is blessed by runes from another reality, dealing 1d6 additional damage (5d6). While the user is in the Seriously or Mortally Wounded Wound State and rolls for damage with this weapon, any of its damage die that land on a 1 are re-rolled until they result in a higher value. When this weapon’s user is targeting someone with a Reputation at least 2 higher than their own, this weapon deals 1d6 additional damage (5d6; 6d6 if blessed).

Fabrication: Where did you— How— ... huh? (Cannot be fabricated, must be found or gifted)
Range: 4m/yds

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
